title: Anduril Tapped to Lead NGC2 Common Data Baseline | Rune Technologies News
summary: The US Army selected Anduril to lead its Next-Generation Command and Control common data baseline effort, partnering with Palantir and Raft to create an integrated data mesh system across Army formations.
body_markdown:
Tectonic covered Rune Technologies by Barratt Dewey in a piece titled “Anduril Tapped to Lead NGC2 Common Data Baseline.” The US Army selected Anduril to lead its Next-Generation Command and Control common data baseline effort, partnering with Palantir and Raft to create an integrated data mesh system across Army formations.


Read the full article[here](https://www.tectonicdefense.com/anduril-tapped-to-lead-ngc2-common-data-baseline/) .
